title: Schedule redesign
lede: One master list for everyone. A week jump bar and chips replace the List/Calendar toggle and the filter sheet, and rows drop the bordered card. The list loads week by week: the future is endless, and the past is a deliberate pull.

sections.heading: Top of list
sections.note: Same fixture scenario, device, appearance and scroll (top). Fixture times are relative to launch, so live states and clock differ by a few minutes.

pairs.title: Today and Tomorrow
pairs.beforeCap: A List/Calendar toggle and a filter icon; bordered cards with a time gutter, a rail and a chevron.
pairs.afterCap: A week strip, event type chips, and My Shifts and Sport toggles in the toolbar. Rows are grouped with a bold start time on the right. Your shifts are tinted blue, and Trade Board shows a count badge.

sections.heading: New states (after only)
sections.note: These states have no direct before equivalent. The old Calendar mode, a month grid above a selected-day list, is shown as the first image for reference.

shots.title: Old Calendar mode
shots.cap: Old Calendar mode: a separate month grid above one day's events.

shots.title: Month grid
shots.cap: The month title expands the strip into a grid over the same list. Neighbouring-month days bleed in muted, and tapping a date jumps to it.

shots.title: Day jump
shots.cap: Tapping Thursday in the strip. The list scrolls there with the header pinned, the strip highlights the day, and Today appears.

shots.title: Pulled into the past
shots.cap: A held pull past the top crosses a haptic threshold, and releasing reveals two past weeks. Sep 14 keeps its tint from your past shift.

shots.title: Past folds away
shots.cap: Back on today or later and at rest, the past hides again, so a hard flick or a status-bar tap stops on today.

shots.title: Endless future
shots.cap: Future weeks prefetch ahead of the scroll. Weeks with nothing scheduled keep a short placeholder, so the week bar keeps moving.

changes.was: Calendar mode split the schedule into a month grid plus one day's events.
changes.now: One master list stays put. The week strip, or the month grid it expands into, just scrolls the list to a day.

changes.was: My Shifts, event type, sport and past events all lived in a large sheet, with a summary bar afterward.
changes.now: My Shifts and Sport are toolbar toggles; event type is a row of chips; sport and past-event filters show as removable chips.

changes.was: Bordered card, time gutter, venue rail, pin icon and chevron on every row.
changes.now: Rows sit in rounded day groups under pinned headers, with a venue dot, one meta line, and a bold start time on the right.

changes.was: A blue line with an icon.
changes.now: The whole row is tinted blue. A Student call time replaces the end time; area and gear move to Event detail and VoiceOver.
Everyone sees coverage; it is grey when full and tinted when short.

changes.was: Trade Board only showed a filled icon; a hand-drawn badge had been clipped by the glass toolbar.
changes.now: The native toolbar badge shows the count unclipped.

changes.was: The strip and grid drew house, arrow and grid glyphs under each day.
The list held every upcoming event and stopped at the last one. Past events needed a staff-only toggle.
changes.now: Week windows load as you scroll. The future prefetches, and the past, open to every role, sits behind a deliberate pull with a haptic. It replaces pull-to-refresh on this list.

verification: npm run ios:xcode:verify on iPhone 18 Pro Max (UDID): drift, gap audit, simulator build, XCTest, generic device build.

ScheduleScreenshotUITests pass, including the new windowed-scrolling test: a flick stops at today, a held pull reveals Sep 14, later weeks load, and the past folds back. EventDetailScreenshotUITests pass too.

Full Vitest passes except one test from unrelated in-flight notification work (ios-system-hardening-contract APNs count). New: tests/ios-schedule-windowed-scrolling.test.ts. tsc, verify:docs and git diff --check are clean.
notes: Fixture captures only. Authenticated device, TestFlight and physical-device testing are still to do, including how the pull threshold feels under a real finger.
The fixture harness now filters events and shifts by the requested window, like the routes do.
A push deep link to an event outside the loaded weeks still opens 'Event unavailable'. Fetching a single event by id would close that gap.
Accessibility text sizes were not reworked (D-053).
